reply: {"action":"run_code","code":"const repo='acme/api'; const args={repo,state:'open' as const,label:'bug'}; const candidates:any[]=[]; for(let page=1;page;){const result:any=await tools.list_issues({...args,page}); candidates.push(...result.items.filter((issue:any)=>issue.comments>5)); page=result.next_page;} const q='repo:acme/api is:open label:bug no:assignee'; const initial:any=await tools.search_issues({q}); const matches=new Set<number>(initial.items.map((issue:any)=>issue.number)); const pending=candidates.filter(issue=>!matches.has(issue.number)); const words=[...new Set(pending.map(issue=>issue.title.split(' ')[0]))]; const results=await Promise.all(words.map(async word=>({word,result:await tools.search_issues({q:`${q} ${word}`}) as any}))); const unresolved:any[]=[]; for(const {word,result} of results){for(const issue of result.items)matches.add(issue.number); if(result.incomplete_results){unresolved.push(...pending.filter(issue=>issue.title.split(' ')[0]===word&&!matches.has(issue.number)));}} const stillUnresolved=[]; for(const issue of unresolved){const result:any=await tools.search_issues({q:`${q} ${issue.title}`}); if(result.items.some((item:any)=>item.number===issue.number))matches.add(issue.number); else if(result.incomplete_results)stillUnresolved.push(issue.number);} return {count:candidates.filter(issue=>matches.has(issue.number)).length,unresolved:stillUnresolved};","answer":""}
